full.description: This is a clinical photograph focusing on the face of an infant. The image displays a severe congenital facial anomaly, specifically a bilateral cleft lip and palate with a prominent protruding mass of tissue from the upper lip and nasal area. The surrounding facial structures are visible, and the features are characteristic of a major craniofacial malformation. The overall presentation is consistent with a severe form of cleft lip and palate.
